name: notes
description: Use the OS notes integration to query and manage native macOS Notes.app, listing folders and accounts, searching notes by title or body, reading note content, creating new notes, updating existing notes, and deleting notes. Use whenever the user asks about their notes, for example "save this as a note", "find my note about the vendor contract", or "what did I write about the Q3 plan". Use even when you think you know the answer, Notes state is dynamic, only the live API reflects current content, folder structure, and iCloud-sync updates. Do not use for non-macOS systems, other note apps (Obsidian, Bear, Logseq, Notion, etc.), or generic note-taking-methodology advice.
